linkedin.text:
🚨 Your trading agent burns context rediscovering your watchlist every single session.

The usual approach? Chat with an AI that forgets everything, fumbles your broker credentials, and can't persist work between conversations.

OpenAlice maps trading onto the workspace coding agents already understand: git repos, markdown issues, tracked entities, and durable reports.

✅ Agents collaborate through issues and inbox delivery, not disappearing chat history
✅ Trading becomes staged commits with approval gates instead of direct order firing
✅ Everything runs local with sealed credentials and file-backed state you can inspect

The repo hit experimental beta with workspaces, scheduled runs, market data CLIs, and unified broker account support.

⭐ 2.2k stars and growing fast.

🚀 GitHub search: TraderAlice/OpenAlice

Are you building trading automation with AI agents? What's your biggest workflow pain right now?
